sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Shawn E. Lott is from Riverton, Utah, and graduated from Riverton High School in 2006. He graduated from the Salt Lake Community College Police Academy in April 2014. He has worked for the American Fork Police Department since 2014. He is married to Hollie M. Lott, whose maiden name is Gurr.
